request.style: English, deep male baritone with gospel choir, piano, organ, cello, snare drum, soaring gospel, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The hour has come for the Son of Man
to be glorified in this place
Truly, truly, I tell you now
what the grain of wheat will face

[Pre-Chorus]
Unless it falls into the earth
and dies within the dark
it remains alone, a single seed
with no life to mark

[Chorus]
But if it dies, it bears much fruit
the hidden life breaks through
Whoever loves his life loses it
while hate keeps it for you

[Verse]
Whoever hates his life in this world
will keep it for eternal life
If anyone serves me, follow close
where I am, he will strive

[Pre-Chorus]
Where I am, there my servant will be
honored by the Father’s hand
No servant stands alone in this
the Father’s love commands

[Chorus]
But if it dies, it bears much fruit
the hidden life breaks through
Whoever loves his life loses it
while hate keeps it for you

[Bridge]
Now my soul is troubled deeply
what shall I say to the sky
Father, save me from this hour
is the prayer that rises high

[Outro]
No, for this purpose I came
to stand in this hour
The grain falls, the fruit rises
the glory is ours
